Package com.societegenerale.failover.dashboard.security

Interface DashboardAuthenticationConfigurer

public interface DashboardAuthenticationConfigurer
Extension point for plugging an arbitrary authentication mechanism onto the dashboard's own HttpSecurity chain, without re-implementing the parts every mechanism shares: the securityMatcher(basePath + "/**"), the FailoverSecurityProvider authorization wiring, and the DashboardAccessDeniedHandler.

Declare a bean of this type to secure the dashboard UI/API with anything the built-in mechanisms (HTTP Basic, OAuth2 login, OAuth2 resource server) don't cover — a trusted-header identity forwarded by a reverse proxy (e.g. oauth2-proxy, Envoy), SAML, mTLS-derived principals, an existing enterprise AuthenticationProvider, or a client_credentials-only shop that wants the dashboard to sit behind its own gateway's authentication entirely. Takes priority over every built-in mechanism when a bean of this type is present.

configure is called after securityMatcher and authorizeHttpRequests are already applied to the given http — implementations add only the authentication step (e.g. http.oauth2ResourceServer(...), http.addFilterBefore(...), http.x509(...)) and must not call securityMatcher or authorizeHttpRequests again.

Anand Manissery
